results.title: What is going wrong in Tamil Nadu’s SIR? | Focus Tamil Nadu - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: elections_process/state: Issues in Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process in Tamil Nadu.

notes.subject: polity
notes.why_in_news: Reports indicate systemic issues in Tamil Nadu’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process, potentially leading to the disenfranchisement of genuine voters due to procedural lapses.
notes.fact_box: The Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is a process conducted by the Election Commission to update and clean voter rolls. In Tamil Nadu, the process is facing criticism due to unrealistic deadlines, confusing forms, and lack of clear instructions, risking the deletion of lakhs of genuine voters.

prelims_pointers.text: The Election Commission of India (ECI) is the constitutional body responsible for the preparation and revision of electoral rolls.
The Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is a periodic exercise to ensure the accuracy of the voter list.
The Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) oversees the implementation of electoral roll revisions at the state level.

notes.mains_question: Discuss the importance of an accurate and inclusive electoral roll in ensuring the integrity of the democratic process in India.

results.title: Manipur's violence-hit people, seeking to return home, clash with security forces - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: internal_security/state: Ongoing ethnic violence and internal security situation in Manipur.

notes.subject: security
notes.why_in_news: Clashes between internally displaced persons (IDPs) and security forces in Manipur highlight the ongoing challenges of restoring normalcy and managing ethnic violence.
notes.fact_box: Hundreds of displaced people and security forces clashed in Imphal East district on November 29, 2025. The conflict occurred as IDPs attempted to return to homes in the Senapati district periphery after being housed in relief camps since May 2023.

prelims_pointers.text: Imphal East and Senapati are districts in the state of Manipur.
Ethnic violence in Manipur began in May 2023, leading to large-scale internal displacement.
The Sangai Festival, which began on November 21, 2025, coincided with the recent escalations.

notes.mains_question: Analyze the challenges in managing internal security and rehabilitating internally displaced persons (IDPs) in conflict-affected regions like Manipur.
